whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Biryani Mahal,

I noticed your restaurant has a strong local presence near New Millat Colony in Phulwari Sharif, Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for direct online orders and table bookings.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp ordering, special menu showcase, aur customer reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/biryanimahal

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Biryani Mahal team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and a showcase of your location near New Millat Colony in Phulwari Sharif. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
